metadata.name: GetBalanceTransferHistory
metadata.description: This API is used to get history of a Balance Transfer transaction.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Currency Code Ex. 840 = US Doller. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language ==  en: means use English ---- es: means Spanish Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entitity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Format: XXXXX Example: 12345

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 7314145404 Condition: 1 At least one of AccountID/AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXX Example: 12345 Condition: 1 At least one of AccountID/AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required.

children.name: GetBalanceTransferHistoryLog
children.description: GetBalanceTransferLogModel list

children.name: TransactionID
children.description: Transaction Number for the  transaction being posted. Valid Values:0-9 a-z Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:23654789 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account Number of card holder Valid Values: 0 - 9 Format: xxxx Allowable Values: 19

children.name: PayeeAccountNumber
children.description: Payee’s Account Number for BT (Card No. / Loan Account Number) Valid Values: 0 - 9 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: PayeeAccountType
children.description: Payee account type. 1 – Loan. 2 – Card. Valid Values: 1/2 Format: x

children.name: CardNumber
children.description: Card Number of account holder Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896325874 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: ProductID
children.description: ID assigned to a Program Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXX Example: Fixed value provided by CoreCard.

children.name: AvailableBTAmount
children.description: Available Balance Transfer Amount Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 500.00 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: RequestedBTAmount
children.description: Amount requested for Balance Transfer. Valid Values: 0 - 9 Format: xxxx Example: 500.00 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: CreditorsName
children.description: Creditor entity Name. Valid Values: 0 - 9 a-z Format: xxxx Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PayeeAddressLine1
children.description: Payee Address Line 1. Valid Values: 0 - 9 a-z Format: xxxx Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PayeeAddressLine2
children.description: Payee Address Line 2. Valid Values: 0 - 9 a-z Format: xxxx Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PayeeAddressLine3
children.description: Payee Address Line 3. Valid Values: 0 - 9 a-z Format: xxxx Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PayeeAddressLine4
children.description: Payee Address Line 4. Valid Values: 0 - 9 a-z Format: xxxx Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PayeeCity
children.description: Payee City. Valid Values: 0 - 9 a-z Format: xxxx Allowable Values: 25

children.name: PayeeState
children.description: Payee State. Valid Values: 0 - 9 a-z Format: xxxx Allowable Values: 25

children.name: PayeeCountry
children.description: Payee Country. Valid Values: 0 - 9 a-z Format: xxxx Allowable Values: 25

children.name: PromotionPlanID
children.description: ID of Promo Plan Valid Values: 0 - 9 a-z Format: xxxx Allowable Values: 100

children.name: TransactionDateTime
children.description: Date and Time of transaction occured Valid Values: 0 - 9 Format: MM:DD:YYYY HH/MM/SS Example: 12:11:2020 11/00/00

children.name: ACIStatusCode
children.description: Status Code received from 3rd party Payment gateway (ACI). Valid Values: Check, Electronic, Rejected, Error, Unknown Format: Check Allowable Values: 30

children.name: ACIStatusMessage
children.description: Status message received from 3rd party Payment gateway (ACI). Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Format: xxxx xxxx xxxxx xxxx Example: Your request has been processed Allowable Values: 100

children.name: BTPaymentDate
children.description: BT transaction posting date. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 02/02/2020 11:00:00 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: OriginatorPaymentID
children.description: This is the ID created at the issuer end. This ID will be acting as lifecycle ID. Valid Values: 0 - 9 a-z Format: xxxx Allowable Values: 100

children.name: PaymentStatus
children.description: Pending/Cancelled Allowable Values: 20

children.name: eComPaymentId
children.description: Unique ID received from 3rd party Payment Gateway API (ACI API). Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Format: xxxxxxxxxx Example: 1234567890 Allowable Values: 100

children.name: BTRequestDate
children.description: BT transaction request date. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 02/02/2020 11:00:00

children.name: PayeeName
children.description: Payee name Valid Values:a-z Format : XXXX Example : John

children.name: CIN
children.description: Customer Identification Number. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxxxxx Example: 1234568 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PayeePostalCode
children.description: Payee’s Postal Code. Valid Values: 0 - 9 Format: xxxx Allowable Values: 9

children.name: BatchId
children.description: The identifier of the batch, which is assigned by the system. Valid Values:0-9 Example:1234 Allowable Values: 5

children.name: AdjustmentAmount
children.description: The amount received in the adjustment file from 3rd party payment gateway. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxxx Example: 1234

children.name: AdjustmentDate
children.description: Date when amount is reverse posted as mentioned in Adjustment File received from 3rd party payment gateway (ACI). Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 02/02/2020 11:00:00

children.name: TransactionFeeAmount
children.description: Transaction Fee Amount ($). Valid Values: 0 - 9 Format: xxxx

children.name: TotalTransactionAmount
children.description: Sum of requested BT amount and Transaction Fees. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxxx Example: 1234
